subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Which path should own the Feishu underscore-URL fix: refresh or adopt an existing linked candidate, permit a fresh narrow same-repository replacement, or defer until live Feishu proof is available?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but this issue is paired with open conflict-marked fork PRs and labels that tell automation not to spawn another fix without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt or refresh a linked candidate
options.body: Use the best existing candidate as source, resolve conflicts, require focused Feishu proof, and land the fix through a same-repository PR.

options.title: Allow a fresh narrow replacement
options.body: Clear the no-new-fix-pr path and let a repair worker create a plugin-local PR with regression tests and source-candidate credit.

options.title: Defer for live Feishu proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or contributor can verify the renderer behavior in a real Feishu tenant and choose the final normalization shape.

recommendation.title: Adopt or refresh a linked candidate
recommendation.body: Use the best existing candidate as source, resolve conflicts, require focused Feishu proof, and land the fix through a same-repository PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path and release-line work make this the best available routing owner for choosing the fix path.
